title: Decision: draft-mahy-mimi-msgid-aad-03 is track-only for mimid (small if wanted)
description:
Assay mimid-1wgh.44.7 of /home/mark/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-mahy-mimi-msgid-aad-03.txt (224 lines, read whole; sha256 in specs/PROVENANCE).

What it is: one optional Safe AAD component, message_id (suggested 0x0040, Where: AD; L156-160), carrying the content-10 §3.3 Message ID of an application/mimi-content message so providers can see it (L127-134). Informational (L7), single author, Acknowledgments TODO (L205).

RECOMMEND: track only. Reasons: individual draft; its value is debugging and log correlation at providers, which mimid can get today from its own logs; the value is unverifiable by providers (see wg bead). If Mark wants it later it is small: (1) mimi-mls Member::send adds the item when the room's safe_aad lists 0x0040 (member.rs send path already takes items, ~L1309-1327); (2) the hub logs it beside room_id on message_accepted (hub/submit.rs; the SafeAAD parser safe_aad_items already exists); (3) a room setting to list 0x0040 in safe_aad at creation.

No conflict: the hub finds frank_aad among any items (hub/submit.rs:303-316); members accept and surface all items when Safe AAD is on (member.rs apply_processed ~L1213-1229). 0x0040 is free (Rohan's coordination gist lists message_id 0x0040, citing -02). Not related to JMAP senderMsgId (a mimid ULID, decision JM-9 / mimid-1wgh.12.26).
